title: Early-Payment Discount Terms by Tier — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
**Appendix to the account terms of Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms): early-payment discount.**

The early-payment discount is a discount for paying an invoice in full early, stated as a percent of the merchandise amount. The discount period is the number of calendar days after the invoice date within which full payment earns the discount; a discount period of 0 means there is no early-payment discount on that tier. Certain invoice components are never discounted for early payment.

| Terms tier | Discount (percent of the merchandise amount) | Discount period (calendar days after the invoice date) | Components never discounted | Proportional discount on a partial payment inside the period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 0.0 | 0 (none) | Sales tax; delivery fees | No |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 0.0 | 0 (none) | Sales tax; delivery fees | No |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 1.0 | 10 | Sales tax; delivery fees | No |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 1.0 | 10 | Sales tax; delivery fees | No |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 1.0 | 10 | Sales tax; delivery fees | No |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 0.0 | 0 (none) | Sales tax; delivery fees | No |

### Reading the appendix

- **Tiers with a discount.** Net 30 Preferred, Net 45 Volume and Net 60 Enterprise carry a 1.0 percent discount with a 10-day discount period.
- **Tiers without one.** Net 15, Net 30 Standard and Net 30 Public Sector carry a discount period of 0, which means none.
- **Excluded components.** On every tier, sales tax and delivery fees are never discounted for early payment.
- **Partial payments.** On no tier does a partial payment inside the discount period earn a proportional discount.

### Illustration (hypothetical invoice)

A hypothetical invoice on a tier with a 1.0 percent discount totals $1300.00, made up of $1200.00 of merchandise, $60.00 of sales tax and $40.00 of delivery fees. The discountable amount is the $1200.00 of merchandise only, and 1.0 percent of it is $12.00. On a tier whose discount period is 0, the same invoice earns no early-payment discount.
